disclaimer.short: Estimates only — verify with a tax advisor, isännöitsijä, and licensed professionals.
disclaimer.long: All figures are estimates based on your inputs and editable configuration. They are not financial, tax or legal advice and are not guarantees of any outcome. Verify tax treatment with a tax advisor, housing-company matters with the isännöitsijä (property manager), and technical work with licensed professionals.

taloyhtio.explanation: Housing company (asunto-osakeyhtiö). Owns the building; you buy shares that give the right to occupy an apartment.

asuntoOsake.explanation: Housing company shares. Most Finnish apartments and many rowhouses are sold as shares, not real estate.

kiinteisto.explanation: Real estate — land and building owned directly. Transfer tax is higher than for shares.

hoitovastike.explanation: Monthly maintenance fee paid to the housing company for running costs.

rahoitusvastike.explanation: Monthly financing fee that pays down the housing company's loans (e.g. for a pipe renovation).

velkaosuus.explanation: The apartment's share of the housing company's loans. Added to the sale price to get the debt-free price.

velatonHinta.explanation: Debt-free price = sale price + debt share. Comparable prices in Finland are usually quoted debt-free.

myyntihinta.explanation: Sale price — what the buyer pays the seller, excluding the debt share.

varainsiirtovero.explanation: Transfer tax paid by the buyer. Rates are editable in settings.

isannoitsija.explanation: Property manager of the housing company.

isannoitsijantodistus.explanation: Property manager's certificate: the housing company's finances, loans, completed and planned renovations. Always request before an offer.

pts.explanation: Pitkän tähtäimen suunnitelma — the housing company's long-term maintenance plan (typically 5–10 years).

muutostyoilmoitus.explanation: Renovation notice. Shareholders must notify the housing company in writing before renovations that may affect the building (wet rooms, plumbing, electrical, structures). The company may set conditions and supervise.

putkiremontti.explanation: Pipe renovation (linjasaneeraus). Replaces water and sewer pipes, often renewing bathrooms. Typically costs several hundred to over a thousand euros per m².

asbestikartoitus.explanation: Asbestos survey. Required before renovation works in buildings started before 1994.

hankintamenoOlettama.explanation: Deemed acquisition cost for individuals: at least 20 % of the sale price can be deducted (40 % if owned 10+ years).

rivitalo.explanation: Rowhouse / terraced house, usually also a housing company.

risks.title: Risk flags
risks.description: Finnish-specific checks based on the property, housing company and deal numbers.
risks.none: No risk flags. That doesn't mean there are no risks — check the isännöitsijäntodistus and PTS.

asbestos_survey.title: Asbestos survey required before renovation
asbestos_survey.detail: The building is from {buildYear} (before {threshold}). An asbestos survey (asbestikartoitus) is required before works that disturb structures, e.g. wet rooms, flooring, walls. Budget roughly a few hundred to over a thousand euros and some lead time.

pts_major_upcoming.title: Major works planned: {kind} in {year}
pts_major_upcoming.detail: The maintenance plan lists this for {year} ({status}). {estimatedShare, select, other {Estimated share for this apartment: {estimatedShare}.} empty {No cost estimate recorded.}} {beforeSale, select, yes {This falls within your expected holding period.} other {Buyers will price this in at resale.}}

pts_upcoming.title: Planned works: {kind} in {year}
pts_upcoming.detail: The maintenance plan lists this for {year} ({status}). {estimatedShare, select, other {Estimated share: {estimatedShare}.} empty {No cost estimate recorded.}}

pipe_renovation_overdue.title: Pipe renovation may be due
pipe_renovation_overdue.detail: {renovated, select, yes {Pipes were last renovated in {referenceYear}} other {No pipe renovation on record; the building is from {referenceYear}}} — {age} years ago, and none is in the PTS. Ask the isännöitsijä whether a putkiremontti is being prepared; it affects both price and resale.

renovation_notice_required.title: Renovation notice (muutostyöilmoitus) needed
renovation_notice_required.detail: Notify the housing company in writing before starting works on wet rooms, plumbing, electrical, ventilation or structures. Allow time for review and possible conditions or supervision at your cost.

missing_manager_certificate.title: No isännöitsijäntodistus recorded
missing_manager_certificate.detail: Request the property manager's certificate before making an offer. It lists the company's loans, completed and planned renovations.

missing_maintenance_plan.title: No maintenance plan (PTS) recorded
missing_maintenance_plan.detail: Request the PTS and add planned works so they can be priced into the deal.

high_debt_share.title: High debt share
high_debt_share.detail: The debt share is {ratio} of the debt-free price (flag above {limit}). Check the loan terms and future rahoitusvastike.

leased_plot.title: Leased plot (vuokratontti)
leased_plot.detail: Check the ground lease term and upcoming rent increases; they affect vastike and resale price.

individual_business_income.title: Frequent flipping may be taxed as business income
individual_business_income.detail: If you buy and sell apartments regularly as an individual, the Tax Administration may treat it as business activity rather than capital gains. Confirm with a tax advisor.

expected_loss.title: Expected case loses money
expected_loss.detail: The expected scenario ends at {amount} after tax. Renegotiate the price or revisit the renovation scope.

worst_case_loss.title: Worst case loses money
worst_case_loss.detail: The worst-case scenario ends at {amount} after tax. Make sure you can absorb that.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.debt_share_unchanged_at_sale: Debt share is assumed unchanged at sale; rahoitusvastike is treated fully as a cost (conservative).
assumptions.interest_only_loan: Loan is interest-only during the holding period and financed against the purchase price.
assumptions.vat_not_deductible: VAT is added to renovation and agent costs because selling housing shares is VAT-exempt (no input VAT deduction).
assumptions.vat_deductible: Your workspace is set to deduct input VAT; costs are shown excluding VAT.
assumptions.individual_holding_costs_not_deductible: For individuals, holding costs (vastike, interest, utilities) are treated as non-deductible from the capital gain.
assumptions.individual_presumption_applied: The deemed acquisition cost (hankintameno-olettama) was larger than actual costs and was used.
assumptions.company_losses_not_carried: Losses are shown with zero tax; loss carry-forward is not modelled.
assumptions.real_estate_no_debt_share: Debt share is ignored for real estate.

landing.tagline: Flip apartments and rowhouses in Finland with numbers you can trust.
landing.sub: Deal analysis built for housing company shares, renovation planning, AI-assisted suggestions and project tracking — in one place, hosted in the EU.
landing.f1d: Debt-free price, transfer tax, vastike, holding and selling costs — with best, expected and worst cases side by side.
landing.f2d: Upcoming putkiremontti and facade works from the PTS, asbestos surveys for pre-1994 buildings, and the muutostyöilmoitus process.
landing.f3d: Give investors and homeowners a clean read-only or comment view of the deal and plan.
